'''Arkadia's museum''' was a [[Museum/Legends|museum]] that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Calimondretta]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Syned]]. It was established by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Arkadia Calimondra]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Sith Wars]] and in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], Calimondra met with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] inside the museum. The museum was later damaged when the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] unit [[Rusher's Brigade]] staged an [[Siege of Calimondretta|attack]] on Calimondretta.<ref name="Knight Errant">[[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']]</ref>

==Description==
The [[Museum/Legends|museum]] was located in a large room and its exhibits were situated inside small, elevated alcoves that were built into in the room's walls. Among the artifacts on display were a translation device that had been used by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Fillorean]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during negotiations with the [[Duinuogwuin/Legends|Duinuogwuin]] [[Species/Legends|species]]; a [[Holorecorder/Legends|holorecorder]] that had been used to interview the philosopher [[Laconio]]; a [[Diamond/Legends|diamond]] bit that had been used during time of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] by a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] working in a [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] [[Mining/Legends|mine]]; and a [[Fusioncutter/Legends|fusioncutter]] that had been used by a [[Sith trooper (Sith Empire)|Sith trooper]] to board the ''[[Endar Spire]]'',<ref name="Knight Errant" /> a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]] [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] that served during the [[Jedi Civil War]] and was [[Attack on the Endar Spire|destroyed]] in orbit above [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>
